**Version:** Secure June 2026 Release 1/2  
**Source:** <https://trebuco.atlassian.net/projects/ENG/versions/25693/tab/release-report-all-issues>

This release is marked as **released** and includes customer-facing fixes, UI improvements, platform cohesion updates, reporting fixes, and secure module enhancements.

# Release summary

This release contains a broad set of engineering changes across Secure and related modules, with the largest concentration in UI modernization, incident and audit workflows, reporting stability, user management, and data/platform cohesion work. Most items are complete, with a small number still in validation states and worth monitoring after rollout.

| Area | Highlights | Release impact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Incident and case management | UI updates for incident pages, suspect grid, incident list, validation, case review, and security/user mapping improvements | Improves consistency, usability, and reliability for incident-driven workflows |
| Audit and document workflows | Unified document and audit management pages, audit workbench improvements, action plan/detail enhancements, and upload experience upgrades | Reduces friction for teams managing audits and supporting documents |
| Reporting and exports | Fixes for Izenda filters and intermittent failures, Excel export defects, and OSHA-related reporting work | Improves confidence in exported data and report usability |
| Platform cohesion and data migration | User creation, store identity, migration procedure fixes, location hierarchy alignment, and pipeline/container registry updates | Strengthens platform compatibility and deployment reliability |

# What shipped

## Customer-facing improvements

- [ENG-4210](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4210) — Unify the document/audit management pages
- [ENG-4195](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4195) — Incident validation for required fields
- [ENG-4174](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4174) — Calypso lightbox button improvements
- [ENG-4032](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4032) — Calypso toolbar button improvements
- [ENG-3882](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3882) — Document management upload improvements, including multi-file and drag-and-drop support
- [ENG-3227](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3227) — Audit action plan detail UX enhancement
- [ENG-4094](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4094) — Calypso UI incident list page improvements
- [ENG-4092](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4092) — Audit workbench UI improvements
- [ENG-4033](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4033) — Budget setup UI improvements
- [ENG-3722](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3722) and [ENG-3721](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3721) — SRMS page improvements

## Bug fixes and reliability improvements

- [ENG-4179](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4179) — Intermittent Izenda report failures in PC mode fixed
- [ENG-4199](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4199) — Izenda report filters not showing in Platform Cohesion mode fixed
- [ENG-4070](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4070) — Foot Locker Excel export/login loop fixed
- [ENG-4066](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4066) — TJX CA Excel export discrepancy fixed
- [ENG-4106](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4106) — CAMS Search Audit filtering fixed
- [ENG-4224](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4224) — Snowflake overshort chart issue fixed
- [ENG-4134](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4134) — Snowflake event viewer timing issue fixed
- [ENG-3434](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3434) — Award module issue fixed
- [ENG-2777](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-2777) — Audit template typing issue fixed
- [ENG-1926](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1926) — Quick Entry submission issue fixed

## Platform and backend changes

- [ENG-4014](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4014) — Universal model API release pipeline updated to use the apprissretail container registry
- [ENG-4223](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4223) — Migration stored procedure join and truncation issues fixed
- [ENG-4088](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4088) — LPUser view updated to prefer LHUA over LPUser2 for StoreIdent
- [ENG-3805](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3805) — Division/Region/District aligned to alternate location hierarchy levels
- [ENG-3391](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3391) — Incident SecurityID issue on new mapped users fixed
- [ENG-4064](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4064) — Incident user switched from IncidentApp to IncidentUser for Lunar
- [ENG-4171](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4171) — Missing async search procedure index added
- [ENG-2789](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-2789) — Continued workflow redesign for Engage Data Processor / ETL engine migration

# Items to monitor post-release

A few issues in this version are not yet in a final done state. They may be deployed as part of the release train, but they still require verification or follow-up.

- [ENG-4411](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4411) — New user creation issue in platform cohesion migration context READY FOR TEST
- [ENG-4408](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4408) — Regex validation condition parameter needs to be re-added READY FOR TEST
- [ENG-4401](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4401) — UI Audit Screen READY FOR TEST
- [ENG-4398](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4398) — UI Suspect Grid READY FOR TEST
- [ENG-4392](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4392) — UI Incident Page updates READY FOR TEST
- [ENG-4222](https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4222) — Incident Admin Module QA bug fixes IN TESTING
